title: Learning with AI
description: Copy-paste tutor prompt that helps a person learn the concepts behind a Question in their reasoning tree, iteratively and with knowledge checks.

variables.name: situationPreface
variables.description: Optional civic context lines (e.g. level of government and place) shown before the tree context.

variables.name: ancestorLines
variables.description: Ancestor nodes from tree root to parent, each formatted as `label: text`.

variables.name: childLines
variables.description: Direct children of the Question (unverified notes), each formatted as `label: text`.

surfaces: My Vision → Options → Learning with AI (`learning_with_ai`: a Question under a civic scope, without its own civic scope key)

usage.notes: Copy-only workflow; there is no paste-back step.
